limitations: Finite synthetic safety study; no holdout tasks or universal safety claim.
Baseline retains retail scope, business/effect, version and transport checks.
No configurable refund-dollar ceiling; returns record requests without refund movement.
Scripted responses measure harness behavior, never Luna ASR.
Live outputs are persisted for exact replay; generation is not deterministic.

Prompt-only arm receives trusted authority status (consent, approval, ownership, scope, version currency) as explicit server facts; it measures whether injected text overrides those facts, not whether a model can establish authority itself. Stale-authority races that occur after the model's decision are, by construction, invisible to it.
